title: Hyperparameter sensitivity of bsc_7 (one at a time; development seeds 43, 46; descriptive)
design: Each arm changes exactly one detector hyperparameter of the final bsc_7 configuration to a lower and a higher value; each arm refits its own calibration from the same controls/captures/cached measurements (no training, no inference) and runs the Phase 2d attack as --development-gate-run filter runs on seeds 43 and 46. Reference: logs/bsc7_devgate (defaults). Clean false-alarm behaviour comes from each calibration's leave-one-seed-out transfer check.
not_varied: max_consecutive_holds only acts when a round is invalid (none on these seeds); reported from the Stage 3c reruns instead.
reported: LOSO clean FPR of the calibration
status: Development evidence on two seeds; shows how sensitive results are to each setting, not a confirmatory claim.
